title: Romans say Phoenicians sacrificed children to Molech
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Romans say Phoenicians sacrificed children to Molech, about antiquity at Sardinia / Phoenicia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: their rights, including according to the Romans, they sacrificed their children to Molech.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher who talks about ancient giants and lost peoples, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people who also settled on the island of Sardinia. Alberino says that according to the Romans, the Phoenicians sacrificed their children to Molech, a god named in ancient writings. He raises it as part of a darker picture of these ancient people.
